newsitem.title: USA: Excel Ottumwa, Ia, pork plant closed for the week.
newsitem.headline: Excel Ottumwa, Ia, pork plant closed for the week.

text.p: The fire-damaged Excel Corp pork plant in Ottumwa, Iowa, will be closed the rest of this week, as roof insulation continues to smolder after a fire that broke out late Sunday, Excel and fire officials said.
"We won't be in operation the rest of this week. We're just starting to get in today to do a preliminary assessment," said Mark Klein, Excel spokesman.
Excel, based in Wichita, Kan., is a unit of Cargill Inc.
Klein said the smoldering roof insulation slowed the inspection process. He said the company will not know when the facility will reopen until engineers inspect the plant.
Fire fighters were on "stand-by" mode Tuesday, hoping the smoldering insulation will die down on its own, said an Ottumwa Fire Department spokesman.
No one was injured in the fire, and the cause has not been determined. Also, no damage estimates were released.
The plant can slaughter 9,600 hogs daily, but that production has since been shifted to Excel plants in Beardstown, Ill., and Marshall, Mo., Klein said.
